title: Request for on demand system information

entities.name: On-demand System Information Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request system information that is not currently broadcast, using random access and RRCSystemInfoRequest message.

entities.name: Timer T319a
entities.description: Timer that must not be running for the SI request procedure to be initiated.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: Contains scheduling information and configuration for requesting other system information.

entities.name: SI Request Configuration
entities.description: Configuration parameters for requesting system information via random access.

entities.name: RRCSystemInfoRequest Message
entities.description: RRC message used to request system information from the network.

entities.name: T319a not running
entities.description: Precondition for initiating the SI request procedure.

entities.name: SI broadcast status notBroadcasting
entities.description: Condition where the required SI message is not being broadcast by the cell.

entities.name: Acquire requested SI messages
entities.description: Action to acquire the requested system information messages immediately after acknowledgement.

entities.name: Release RLC entity for SRB0
entities.description: Action to release the RLC entity for Signaling Radio Bearer 0 during cell reselection.

relations.description: SI request procedure requires that timer T319a is not running.
Procedure execution depends on configuration parameters in SIB1.
Procedure includes transmission of RRCSystemInfoRequest message.
Procedure results in acquisition of requested SI messages after acknowledgement.
SI request is only performed for messages with broadcast status set to notBroadcasting.
SIB1 contains SI request configuration parameters.
Procedure may result in release of SRB0 RLC entity during cell reselection.
